_meta.description: Trip knowledge base for the Marmorstein family Austria bot. Feed this to the Claude agent as context/tools. Extend freely — attractions list covers the majors + all booking-critical items.

family.notes: Shomer Shabbat + kashrut. No driving/activities/phone on Shabbat — everything for Shabbat must be arranged before candle-lighting.

_meta.bot_persona: Warm, concise Hebrew-speaking family trip companion. Proactive but not naggy. Always considers weather, drive time, Shabbat, kid ages (5yo tires/naps), and what needs pre-booking.

zell_kaprun_summer_card.name: Zell am See-Kaprun Sommerkarte
zell_kaprun_summer_card.how_to_get: Collect free from the Kaprun apartment-hotel reception on arrival.
zell_kaprun_summer_card.covers_area: Kaprun / Zell am See region (days Aug 19-23)

salzburgerland_card.name: SalzburgerLand Card
salzburgerland_card.how_to_get: Buy the 12-day version (price gap vs 6-day is small). Have it before the first SalzburgerLand attraction (Aug 23).
salzburgerland_card.covers_area: Wider Salzburgerland (Krimml, Gastein, Golling, Hallein salt mine, Salzburg city, most spas & lakes)
salzburgerland_card.salzburg_city_rule: In Salzburg city, the card gives free entry to all city attractions for 24h from first validation. Do the city in one day (Aug 30).

days.summary: Evening flight ~18:00, land in Prague, overnight in Prague.
Morning: pick up rental car at airport. Drive Prague -> Kaprun (~4.5-5h). Settle in, groceries.

days.title: Kitzsteinhorn (snow), mountain slides, gorge
days.weather_rule: Do Kitzsteinhorn on a clear/partly-cloudy day for the panorama — swap with another Kaprun day if tomorrow is clearer.

days.title: Schmittenhöhe / Kitzlochklamm / Tauern Spa — SHORT DAY (Shabbat comes in)
days.shabbat_note: Candle-lighting ~19:45-20:00 (VERIFY). Be back and cooking done early. Prep all Shabbat food today.

days.title: Shabbat — rest in Kaprun. No driving/activities.
Krimml Falls OR 10-Slides trail + secret lake
days.choice_note: Pick ONE main: Krimml falls (~55min) OR 10-slides (~40min). Unlikely to do both.

days.title: Move Kaprun -> Wagrain (~50min) via Liechtenstein Gorge
Woody-Bob cable car, free animal park, Radstadt pools
Gastein valley — Spiegelsee lake, mountain cart, Alpentherme
Golling Falls, Lammerklamm, Gosausee, Aqua Salza
Flachau — Star Jet lift, Lucky Flitzer slides, Jägersee — SHORT DAY (Shabbat)
days.shabbat_note: Candle-lighting ~19:40-19:55 (VERIFY). Prep all Shabbat food today.

days.title: Shabbat — rest in Wagrain. No driving/activities.
Hallein Salt Mine + Salzburg city (guide mislabels this 29.8)
days.note: IMPORTANT: guide labels this 'day 10 = 29.8', but 29.8 is Shabbat. It actually falls Sun 30.8. Salzburg card 24h rule: do all city attractions today.

days.title: Drive back to Prague. Optional one attraction + refresh stop en route.

zell_lake_cruise.name: Lake Zell panorama cruise
zell_lake_cruise.note: Hourly 10:00-17:00. Small fee for upper deck.

thumersbach_lido.name: Lido Thumersbach beach/pool
thumersbach_lido.note: Hot-day option. Indoor pool on the lake also available for cool days.

kitzsteinhorn.name: Kitzsteinhorn 3029m + Ice Arena snow park
kitzsteinhorn.note: Snow park July-Aug. Do on a CLEAR day.

maisiflitzer.name: Maisiflitzer mountain slide
maisiflitzer.note: NOT included in card. Buy multi-ride ticket.

sigmund_thun_gorge.name: Sigmund-Thun-Klamm gorge
sigmund_thun_gorge.note: Do the long loop incl. Klammsee lake.

schmittenhohe.name: Schmittenhöhe cable car + kids park
schmittenhohe.note: Great for the kids' ages; motorized kids' bikes.

tauern_spa.name: Tauern Spa Kaprun
tauern_spa.note: NOT free with card — card gives +1 bonus hour on a 3h ticket. Best rainy-day option.

krimml_falls.name: Krimml Waterfalls (Europe's highest)
krimml_falls.note: Parking P4/P5 free with card. ~55min from Kaprun. Optional taxi up (~7€/person, pay on site).

ten_slides_wildkogel.name: 10-Slides trail Wildkogel
ten_slides_wildkogel.note: Lift included with card. Slide mats ~3€. Black slides age 7+.

uttendorf_lake.name: Uttendorfer Erlebnisbadesee
uttendorf_lake.note: Hot-day swim lake with water slide.

liechtenstein_gorge.name: Liechtenstein Gorge
liechtenstein_gorge.note: 440 steps total. Go early or after 16:00 (less crowded). Don't bring heavy bags.

wagrain_wasserwelt.name: Wagrain Wasserwelt pools
wagrain_wasserwelt.note: Indoor + outdoor slides. Works on rainy days (indoor part).

obertauern_bobby_lift.name: Bobby scenic lift + pedal-boat lake
obertauern_bobby_lift.note: Wooden ball track 2€ (coins). Bring small change.

untertauern_animal_park.name: Free animal park (feed/catch-your-fish)
untertauern_animal_park.note: Donation-based. Catch a trout, grill on site — big hit with kids.

fulseck_spiegelsee.name: Fulseck lift + Spiegelsee alpine lake walk
fulseck_spiegelsee.note: ~4.5km easy-moderate. Start from the top. Ask at cashier for the map.

alpentherme_bad_hofgastein.name: Alpentherme Gastein
alpentherme_bad_hofgastein.note: Best spa in the region. Free 4h with card.

durrnberg_slides.name: Dürrnberg summer toboggan (2.2km)
durrnberg_slides.note: NOT included in card (Abtenau slides closed 2026). Check open before going.

golling_falls.name: Golling Waterfall
golling_falls.note: Small parking fee (coins). Easy family walk.

gosausee.name: Gosausee lake loop
gosausee.note: 4km flat, stroller-friendly. Lift free with card. Electric boat rental (paid).

aqua_salza.name: Aqua Salza Golling spa
aqua_salza.note: Arrive before dusk for the outdoor hot pool.

flachau_starjet.name: Star Jet 1 lift + Flori's adventure trail

jagersee.name: Jägersee lake
jagersee.note: Easy loop, rowboat rental. Beautiful drive via Kleinarl.

flachau_ebikes.name: Flachau half-electric bike rental
flachau_ebikes.note: Reserve a few days ahead — very popular in summer.

therme_amade.name: Therme Amadé Altenmarkt
therme_amade.note: Free 4h with card. Great late/rainy-day option.

durrnberg_salt_mine.name: Hallein/Dürrnberg Salt Mine
durrnberg_salt_mine.note: RESERVE ONLINE in advance; pick Salzburg tab and enter card number to make it free. Download 'SALZWELTEN' app for Hebrew audio guide.

anif_ropes_park.name: Kletterpark Salzburg (Anif ropes park)
anif_ropes_park.note: CASH ONLY. Reserve ahead (small private park). Toddler course too. Swim lake next door.

bluntausee.name: Bluntausee clear lake
bluntausee.note: 20min walk to a crystal-clear trout lake.

salzburg_natural_history_museum.name: Haus der Natur (Natural History Museum)
salzburg_natural_history_museum.note: Best rainy-day option in the city. Dinosaurs, space, human body.

mozart_birthplace.name: Mozart's Birthplace
mozart_birthplace.note: Short visit; skip if not into it.

reminders.text: Get International Driving Permit for every driver (~8₪, at photo/optics shops)
Activate VOYE eSIM (regional/European for German border crossings) before the flight
Confirm pre-ordered kosher meals for the flight
Meat packed frozen-solid in insulated bag; in Prague hotel put in freezer/fridge overnight
On arrival in Kaprun, get all meat into the apartment freezer ASAP
Buy 2x Vignette toll stickers at a gas station near the Austrian border; ask them to punch your dates (>10 days needs 2)
Tell the rental desk you'll cross into Germany (cross-border insurance ~25-30€)
Collect the free Zell am See-Kaprun Summer Card from the apartment reception
Buy the 12-day SalzburgerLand Card (before the Krimml/Salzburgerland day)
Reserve the Gastein/Fulseck Mountain Cart online in advance
Reserve Flachau e-bikes a few days ahead (popular in summer)
Reserve the Hallein Salt Mine online (Salzburg tab + card number = free)
Reserve Anif ropes park ahead — CASH ONLY, bring cash
Prep ALL Shabbat food today; candle-lighting ~19:45-20:00 (verify). Cooking done before then.
Prep ALL Shabbat food today; candle-lighting ~19:40-19:55 (verify). Cooking done before then.
Keep 50c/1-2€ coins for parking meters, toilets, ball-track & fish-food machines

weather_rules._comment: Drive tomorrow's recommendation off Open-Meteo for the base town. These map to the guide's own advice.

clear_or_partly_cloudy.reason: High-mountain viewpoints need clear skies. Kitzsteinhorn especially — don't waste it on a cloudy day.

hot.reason: Lakes and outdoor pools. Bring swimwear, towels, picnic.

rain_or_cold.reason: Thermal spas + indoor museums + the salt mine (indoor). Gorges are fine in light rain too.

agent_rules: Never suggest driving or activities on Shabbat (Fri sunset to Sat night). On Fridays, push everyone to finish early and prep food.
Every recommendation must fit the day's base town and account for drive time + the 5-year-old's stamina (build in a rest/swim).
When an attraction needs_booking=true, surface the reminder the EVENING BEFORE, not the morning of.
cash_only=true attractions -> remind to bring cash that morning.
Match tomorrow's plan to the weather forecast using weather_rules; if the flagship viewpoint day (Kitzsteinhorn) has bad weather, propose swapping days.
Respond in Hebrew, warm and concise. One clear recommendation + 1-2 alternates, not a wall of options.
